newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Postal Savings stops JGB repos with Nomura.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Postal Savings stops JGB repos with Nomura.

text.p: Japan's Postal Savings Bureau has halted Japanese government bond (JGB) repo transactions with Nomura Securities Co Ltd, an official at Japan's Posts and Telecommunications Ministry said on Wednesday.
"We are halting our overall securities business with Nomura Securities for a while, including JGB repo transactions," the official said.
The Postal Savings Bureau is the largest bond lender in the JGB repo market.
The outstanding balance of the bond repo market at the end of March amounted to 17.0371 trillion yen, against 12.8230 trillion yen in February, according to the Japan Securities Dealers' Association.
An official at Nomura said that Japan's Postal Life Insurance Bureau (Kampo), another major bond lender, had already stopped repo transactions with the brokerage.
